prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2017 – Summary (≤500 words)

Core pitch
- Strengthen real opposition to a likely Conservative government; no coalition with Conservatives or Corbyn’s Labour.
- Vision: an open, tolerant, united Britain; strong on scrutiny, especially over Brexit, NHS, education, environment.

Europe and Brexit
- Oppose a hard Brexit; keep UK as close as possible to the EU.
- A referendum on the final deal with an option to remain.
- Priorities: single market/customs union access; guaranteed rights for EU/UK citizens; protect freedom of movement benefits; Erasmus+; security cooperation (Europol/EAW); maintain social, environmental and consumer standards; support for science, business, travel and young people; respect devolved nations and Gibraltar.

NHS and Social Care
- Immediate 1p rise on all Income Tax bands to raise £6bn for NHS/social care; plan for a dedicated health and care tax.
- Cross‑party convention and independent budget watchdog for health/care.
- Integrate health and social care; cap care costs; support carers; end hospital delays.
- Workforce: guarantee EU staff rights; end public sector pay cap; reinstate student nurse bursaries; national workforce plan.
- Mental health: ringfenced funding; waiting-time standards; crisis care; end out‑of‑area placements; perinatal and youth support.

Education and Skills
- Nearly £7bn extra: protect per‑pupil funding; fair formula; protect Pupil Premium.
- No new grammars; restore local democratic role in school places/admissions.
- Early years: triple Early Years Pupil Premium; raise quality.
- Teachers: end 1% pay cap; guaranteed CPD; cut workload.
- Curriculum: slim national core incl. PSHE/SRE, mental health, financial literacy; protect arts.
- Schools and wellbeing: mental health support; free school meals for all primaries; breakfast clubs.
- Universities: reinstate maintenance grants; review finance; protect research and international staff/students; post‑study STEM visas.
- Lifelong learning: expand apprenticeships; adult learning accounts; basic skills by 2030.

Economy, Tax, Work
- Eliminate day‑to‑day deficit by 2020; borrow to invest £100bn in housing (300k homes/yr), FTTP broadband, transport (HS2/Crossrail 2/electrification), schools/hospitals, renewables; new British Housing & Infrastructure Development Bank.
- Fair taxes: reverse recent corporation/CGT cuts; anti‑avoidance; business rates reform; consider land value tax.
- Small business: expand British Business Bank; start‑up allowance.
- Work: living wage path; curb exploitative zero‑hours; gig‑economy rights; pay transparency; stronger enforcement; employee ownership and board representation; financial inclusion duty for FCA.

Environment
- Five green laws (transport, net‑zero, nature, buildings, zero‑waste).
- Air quality: diesel scrappage; ban new diesel cars/vans by 2025; expand ULEZ; EV infrastructure.
- Climate/energy: net‑zero by 2050 (80% by 2040); 60% renewables by 2030; CCS; oppose fracking; nuclear only without subsidy; remain in Euratom.
- Homes: insulate 4m by 2022; restore zero‑carbon homes; boost community energy; increase competition.
- Nature/animal welfare: £2bn flood fund; statutory natural capital targets; expand green/blue belts; tree planting; stronger penalties; ban caged hens; suspend neonicotinoids.
- Waste: 70% recycling by 2022; food waste collections; 5p coffee cup levy; landfill/incineration tax reform.

Families, Housing, Transport, Rural, Culture
- Childcare: extend free hours (from 9 months for working parents over time to 30 hrs/wk); extra paid paternity month; flexible work as a day‑one right.
- Welfare: uprate benefits; scrap two‑child limit/rape clause/bedroom tax; fairer LHA; reform WCA; limit Winter Fuel Payment to higher‑rate taxpayers.
- Housing: build 300k homes/yr; 10 garden cities; lift council borrowing caps; stop overseas pre‑sales; Rent to Own; ban letting fees; 3‑year tenancies; Housing First for rough sleeping.
- Transport: public/customer‑focused rail; allow public bids; take over failing franchises; invest in rail/electrification/HS2‑3/Crossrail 2; shift freight to rail; oppose Heathrow/Gatwick expansion; 16–21 bus discount; empower councils on buses/cycling/smart ticketing.
- Rural: universal superfast broadband; rural services fund; protect Post Office; rural affordable housing.
- Culture/sport: free national museums; protect BBC/Channel 4; creative industries support; safe standing trials.

Rights, Justice, Immigration
- Defend ECHR/Human Rights Act; Digital Bill of Rights; Leveson 2; stronger FOI/media plurality.
- Policing/justice: +£300m for community policing; retain EU tools; body cams; replace PCCs; victims’ rights; presumption against short sentences; restorative justice; women’s/trans prisoners; address BAME disparities.
- Drugs: decriminalise possession; regulate cannabis; move lead to Health.
- Immigration/asylum: efficient/fair system; students out of targets; STEM post‑study visas; Migration Impact Fund; ESOL; 28‑day detention limit; allow work after 6 months; expand Syrian resettlement (50k) and Dubs (3k); protect LGBT+ asylum seekers.
- Equalities: targets/transparency for gender/BAME/LGBT+; name‑blind recruitment; mixed‑sex civil partnerships; modernise GRA; “X” gender marker; decriminalise sex work; period poverty; outlaw caste discrimination; UNCRC into law; accessibility upgrades.

Political Reform and Devolution
- Votes at 16; STV for Commons and local elections; elected Lords; cap donations at £10k; mandatory TV debates; stronger lobbying rules; weekend voting; modern expense rules.
- Constitutional convention; federal UK; devolve repatriated powers; oppose Scottish independence; more powers to Wales; protect NI settlement and single market arrangements; English proportional “England‑only” stage; devolution on demand; retain Barnett, fix Welsh underfunding.
